title: Noeis: reading that compounds
description: Bring in your Kindle highlights, Readwise, books and saved links. Noeis connects each new thing you read to what you already know, and grows a wiki of your own that cites every source.
headline: Everything you read should add up.
lede: Noeis keeps what you read, connects each new book and highlight to what came before, and writes it into a wiki of your own that cites every source.

specimen.title: How small things compound
specimen.grew: A page in your wiki, from 23 sources since March 2025

entries.line: “Habits are the compound interest of self-improvement.”
“Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.”
A line you typed at your reading desk last night ties the two together.
entries.source: Added to the page, with both quotes

statements.title: Bring in what you have already read.
statements.copy: Kindle highlights, Readwise, the books on your desk, links you saved. Years of reading arrive on the first day.

statements.title: Each new thing lands on the old.
statements.copy: Save an article or type a line from a book, and Noeis quotes what it echoes or argues with in everything you have read.

statements.title: A wiki that grows as you read.
statements.copy: Pages are written from your highlights and notes, cite them, and say where two sources disagree. Ask it anything and get your own reading back, or connect Claude Code, Codex and other agents.
